description.value:
Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 115. Category: feat. Trained Feature Feats.

Requires: 5 ranks of Ultra Instinct Mastery Feat and
Mastered Ultra Instinct.
You have stopped considering Ultra Instinct Omen as a
Form, now considering it truly as part of your base
without any of the drawbacks. You may now go into
Ultra Instinct Omen at will. Additionally Ultra Instinct
Omen no longer has a Stamina Cost.
